string.name: text
string.value: While exploring Victoria Island, you bumped into a girl named Sugar.

string.name: text
string.value: She was headed for Ellinia to take her Job Advancement test, but her fear of bugs got in her way.

string.name: text
string.value: You took care of the bugs with ease, but Sugar had a new problem: she said the tree was crying out in pain. And so, you brought medicine for the tree.

string.name: text
string.value: You couldn't help but wonder. Sugar was scared of bugs and could hear trees. Was she really suited to be an Explorer?

string.name: text
string.value: Sugar admitted to sharing your doubts, but she said she had no choice but to keep moving forward, for she had to stop the disaster that was headed toward Maple World...
